data.one_liner: Heroicons from Tailwind Labs as a Flutter icon set including solid, outline, micro and mini styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides all solid, outline, micro, and mini Heroicons from Tailwind Labs for Flutter applications. Offers static icon constants that support tree-shaking as well as optional runtime string lookup via named().
use_when: You need clean, modern UI icons following the Tailwind Heroicons design system.
You want to use tree-shaken static icon constants for smaller app bundles.
avoid_when: You need to use string lookups extensively across a large icon set where tree-shaking is critical.
Your project relies on alternative icon sets like Material Symbols or FontAwesome.
strengths: Includes solid, outline, micro, and mini icon styles.
Supports tree shaking when using static icon classes.
Provides convenient string lookup using named() for dynamic icon resolution.
weaknesses: Tree shaking does not apply when using the runtime string lookup method named().

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer Font Awesome icons over Tailwind's Heroicons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want Lucide icons instead of Heroicons.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need Google's Material Symbols instead of Heroicons.
